description: Remove sets from a session without touching the session itself. Use duplicates_only to undo a log that was sent twice, or exercise to drop one movement that was entered by mistake.

duplicates_only.description: Remove blocks that repeat an identical earlier block in the same session — the fix for a log sent twice. Keeps the first occurrence.

exercise.description: Remove every set of this movement from the session, e.g. "leg press"

workout_id.description: Session id — required only when a date carries more than one session

name: delete_workout_sets
title: Delete workout sets
